---
title: "CDI Relationships"
---

Many Peekbank datasets include parent-reported vocabulary from the
MacArthur-Bates Communicative Development Inventories (CDI). This explorer
relates in-lab word recognition (accuracy or reaction time) to CDI scores,
pairing each test session with the child's closest-in-age CDI administration.

```{ojs cdi-inputs}
cdiNames = manifest.datasets.filter((d) => d.n_subjects_with_cdi > 0).map((d) => d.name)

viewof all_datasets = Inputs.toggle({ label: "All CDI datasets", value: false })
viewof sel_datasets = Inputs.select(cdiNames, {
  label: "Datasets (with CDI)", multiple: 6,
  value: ["adams_marchman_2018", "fernald_marchman_2012", "fmw_2013"],
  format: (d) => datasetLabel(d), disabled: all_datasets,
})
viewof cdi_measure = Inputs.select(
  new Map([["Production", "prod"], ["Comprehension", "comp"]]),
  { label: "CDI measure", value: "prod" })
viewof cdi_scale = Inputs.select(
  new Map([["Raw score", "rawscore"], ["Percentile", "percentile"]]),
  { label: "CDI scale", value: "rawscore" })
viewof lwl_measure = Inputs.select(["Accuracy", "Reaction time"], {
  label: "Recognition measure", value: "Accuracy",
})
viewof analysis_window = interval([-1000, 4000], {
  step: 25, value: [250, 2250], label: "Accuracy window (msec)",
})
viewof age_tol = Inputs.range([0.5, 6], {
  step: 0.5, value: 2, label: "Max age gap (months)",
})
viewof min_trials = Inputs.range([1, 10], {
  step: 1, value: 4, label: "Min trials per session",
})
```

:::

::: {.viz-main}

```{ojs cdi-data}
//| output: false
cdiRaw = d3.json(`${DATA_BASE}cdi.json`)

cdiRows = cdiRaw.rows.map((r) =>
  Object.fromEntries(cdiRaw.columns.map((c, i) => [c, r[i]])))

active_datasets = all_datasets ? cdiNames : sel_datasets
slices = Promise.all(active_datasets.map(loadSlice))

pairedData = {
  const rows = buildRows(slices, { includeExcluded: true, collapseWords: true });
  const byAdmin = d3.group(rows, (r) => `${r.dataset}|${r.aid}`);
  const cdiBySubj = d3.group(
    cdiRows.filter((c) => c.measure === cdi_measure &&
      active_datasets.includes(c.dataset) && c[cdi_scale] != null),
    (c) => `${c.dataset}|${c.subject_id}`);
  const out = [];
  for (const [, g] of byAdmin) {
    const { dataset, aid, subject, age } = g[0];
    const cdis = cdiBySubj.get(`${dataset}|${subject}`);
    if (!cdis || age == null) continue;
    let best = null;
    for (const c of cdis) {
      if (c.age == null) continue;
      const gap = Math.abs(c.age - age);
      if (gap <= age_tol && (!best || gap < best.gap)) best = { ...c, gap };
    }
    if (!best) continue;
    const accs = [];
    const rts = [];
    for (const r of g) {
      const a = windowAccuracy(r.t0, r.runs, analysis_window[0], analysis_window[1]);
      if (a != null) accs.push(a);
      const res = trialRT(r.t0, r.runs);
      if (res && res.rt != null && res.shift_type === "D-T") rts.push(res.rt);
    }
    const lwl = lwl_measure === "Accuracy"
      ? (accs.length >= min_trials ? d3.mean(accs) : null)
      : (rts.length >= Math.max(1, Math.floor(min_trials / 2)) ? d3.mean(rts) : null);
    if (lwl == null) continue;
    out.push({
      dataset, aid, subject, age, lwl, cdi: best[cdi_scale],
      cdi_age: best.age, age_gap: best.gap, instrument: best.instrument_type,
      n_trials: lwl_measure === "Accuracy" ? accs.length : rts.length,
    });
  }
  return out;
}

pearsonR = {
  const xs = pairedData.map((d) => d.lwl);
  const ys = pairedData.map((d) => d.cdi);
  const mx = d3.mean(xs);
  const my = d3.mean(ys);
  let sxy = 0;
  let sxx = 0;
  let syy = 0;
  for (let i = 0; i < xs.length; i++) {
    sxy += (xs[i] - mx) * (ys[i] - my);
    sxx += (xs[i] - mx) ** 2;
    syy += (ys[i] - my) ** 2;
  }
  return sxx > 0 && syy > 0 ? sxy / Math.sqrt(sxx * syy) : NaN;
}
```

```{ojs cdi-count}
html`<p style="color:#6b7280; margin:0 0 0.5rem 0">
${pairedData.length.toLocaleString()} paired sessions ·
r = ${isNaN(pearsonR) ? "—" : pearsonR.toFixed(2)}
(${lwl_measure.toLowerCase()} × CDI ${cdi_measure === "prod" ? "production" : "comprehension"})</p>`
```

::: {.panel-tabset}

### Relationship

```{ojs cdi-scatter}
{
  document.querySelectorAll(".pb-spinner").forEach((el) => el.remove());
  const isAcc = lwl_measure === "Accuracy";
  return Plot.plot({
    width, height: 520, grid: true,
    x: isAcc
      ? { label: "Proportion target looking", domain: [0, 1] }
      : { label: "Reaction time (msec)" },
    y: { label: cdi_scale === "rawscore" ? "CDI raw score" : "CDI percentile" },
    color: { legend: true, label: "Age (months)", scheme: "viridis" },
    marks: [
      Plot.dot(pairedData, {
        x: "lwl", y: "cdi", fill: "age", r: 3, fillOpacity: 0.7, tip: true,
        title: (d) => `${d.dataset}\nage ${d.age} mo (CDI at ${d.cdi_age})\n` +
          `${isAcc ? "acc " + d.lwl.toFixed(2) : "RT " + Math.round(d.lwl) + " ms"}` +
          ` · CDI ${d.cdi}`,
      }),
      Plot.linearRegressionY(pairedData, {
        x: "lwl", y: "cdi", stroke: "#111827", strokeWidth: 2.5,
      }),
    ],
  });
}
```

### By age

```{ojs cdi-by-age}
Plot.plot({
  width, height: 480, grid: true,
  x: { label: "Age at CDI (months)" },
  y: { label: cdi_scale === "rawscore" ? "CDI raw score" : "CDI percentile" },
  color: { legend: true, label: "Dataset" },
  marks: [
    Plot.dot(
      cdiRows.filter((c) => c.measure === cdi_measure &&
        active_datasets.includes(c.dataset) && c[cdi_scale] != null && c.age != null),
      { x: "age", y: cdi_scale, fill: "dataset", r: 2.5, fillOpacity: 0.6 }),
  ],
})
```

All CDI administrations of the selected measure in the selected datasets
(not only those paired with a recognition session).
